poll_interval.description: Seconds between polls of every active pull request. Default: 60.

defaults.description: Settings applied to every pull request unless it overrides them.

pulls.description: Pull requests to merge: objects, or bare pull request URLs.

checks.description: Which checks must pass: all of them, or only those required by branch protection or rulesets. Default: all.
checks.title: Checks

update_branch.description: Update the branch from its base when it is behind. Default: false.
update_branch.title: Update Branch

retry.description: When and how often failed GitHub Actions runs are restarted.

id.description: Name used in depends_on. Default: the URL.

depends_on.description: Ids or URLs of the pull requests that must be merged first; a single string is accepted.
depends_on.title: Depends On

PullEntry.title: PullEntry

RetrySettings.description: When and how often the failed GitHub Actions runs of a pull request are restarted.

max_attempts.description: Batch restarts of failed runs per pull request and head commit. Default: 3.
max_attempts.title: Max Attempts

strategy.description: How the delay grows between restarts: delay, delay × (n+1) or delay × factor^n. Default: exponential.
strategy.title: Strategy

delay.description: Seconds before the first restart. Default: 60.
delay.title: Delay

factor.description: Multiplier per restart for the exponential strategy. Default: 2.
factor.title: Factor

max_delay.description: Upper bound on any delay, in seconds. Default: 3600.
max_delay.title: Max Delay
